title: BRICS Tracker Update — Sun May 24, 2026
summary: Uzbekistan officially joined the New Development Bank on May 22 after President Mirziyoyev ratified the accession agreement, completing the country's domestic ratification process (Senate endorsed May 19). Uzbekistan becomes the first Central Asian NDB member and the latest non-BRICS state in the bank, with a $5B priority project pipeline. Russia's Lavrov signaled at the May 15 press conference that BRICS would 'not rush further expansion,' citing the need to streamline work after doubling membership in 2023-25. Turkey's full BRICS membership remains blocked by India. The timeline and map were updated to reflect the NDB's continued expansion beyond its BRICS parent, and the claims and political sections updated to reflect the expansion-pause signal and Dilma Rousseff's NDB Moscow meeting push for rupee bonds and green finance.

title: BRICS Tracker Update — Sat May 16, 2026
summary: India's BRICS FM Meeting (May 14-15, New Delhi) ended without a joint communiqué after Iran FM Araghchi publicly accused fellow BRICS member UAE of direct military involvement against Iran — prompting UAE to block the joint statement. PM Modi held bilateral meetings with FM Lavrov and FM Araghchi (first India-Iran high-level contact since the Iran conflict escalated). Simultaneously, the NDB held its 11th Annual Meeting in Moscow. RBI-chaired BRICS Payment Task Force (May 12) and FinTech Working Group (May 13) virtual sessions advanced payment infrastructure ahead of the September summit. Claims and political sections updated to reflect the FM meeting's significance for BRICS cohesion; breaking status set to true.
